item.title: Dot Link 0.5.4
item.description: - Dot can use places, forecasts and walking plans you’ve shared to suggest a saved walk when the rain clears or let you know when a forecast changes your plans. - Apple now notarizes Dot Link for Mac. You can open a downloaded copy without choosing Open Anyway. - If you share notifications and are updating from the public 0.5.3 release, grant Accessibility access once for the newly signed app. In System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, remove Dot Link, add it again and turn it on. Later updates keep this permission.
